verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official, well-documented MCP server (zapier.com/mcp, docs.zapier.com/mcp) allowing Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP-compatible client to connect with governed auth and access 9,000+ apps/40,000+ actions, including connection setup, tool bundles, server modes, and security details (SOC 2, SAML SSO). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability beyond vendor docs.
